opinions.text: April 11, 1904. Petition for á writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. John M. Thurston, Mr. J. W. Hughes and Mr. D. W. Burchard for petitioners, Mr. Charles Page, Mr. E. J. McCutchen and Mr. A. B. Browne for respondent.
